fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped LCC 12-pulse converters + DC-link current ODE
source: Kundur (1994) Power System Stability and Control, McGraw-Hill, Ch.10; Arrillaga (1998) High Voltage Direct Current Transmission, 2nd ed., IET; Cigre TB 388 (2009) LCC HVDC; ABB (2019) HVDC Reference Projects.

unit.name: Generic ±500 kV LCC-HVDC Bipole, 1000 MW, 500 km, 12-pulse

V_dc_rated_kV.note: Rated pole-to-ground DC voltage (±500 kV bipole)

Vd0_rect_kV.note: Ideal no-load DC voltage per 6-pulse bridge at rectifier; Vd0 = (3*sqrt(2)/pi)*VLL_sec. Tapped so 2 bridges at alpha~15deg hold ~512 kV (= inverter pole + line drop) at rated 2 kA.

Vd0_inv_kV.note: Ideal no-load DC voltage per 6-pulse bridge at inverter; tapped so 2 bridges at gamma~17deg hold the ~500 kV pole counter-voltage at rated 2 kA (incl. commutation rise).

Xc_ohm.note: Per-bridge commutating reactance (converter transformer leakage), referred to valve side

alpha_rect_deg.note: Rectifier firing (delay) angle; nominal 15-18 deg for reactive economy with margin

gamma_inv_deg.note: Inverter extinction (advance) angle; held >= 15-18 deg to avoid commutation failure

valve_drop_kV.note: Thyristor forward drop per bridge (small, neglected at this fidelity)

loss_factor_station.note: Total station loss as fraction of rated power (0.7% per LCC station; Cigre TB 388, ABB 2019)

P_no_load_MW.note: No-load / auxiliary station loss (cooling, controls, transformer no-load)

line_R_ohm_per_km.note: DC line resistance per km per pole (OHL/XLPE typical)

line_L_mH_per_km.note: DC line series inductance per km per pole

L_smoothing_H.note: Smoothing reactor inductance per terminal (typical 0.1-0.5 H LCC)

C_dc_uF.note: Lumped DC-side capacitance (filters + line shunt); small for LCC current-source link
